items.title: Palo Alto Networks Firewall Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Trigger Denial of Service
items.description: Palo Alto Networks has patched a critical denial-of-service vulnerability in its PAN-OS firewall software, tracked as CVE-2026-0227, which lets unauthenticated attackers disrupt GlobalProtect gateways and portals. The flaw carries a CVSS v4.0 base score of 7.7 (HIGH severity), stemming from improper checks for unusual conditions that force firewalls into maintenance mode after repeated…

items.title: Microsoft SQL Server Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Elevate Privileges over a Network
items.description: Microsoft released security updates on January 13, 2026, addressing a critical elevation of privilege vulnerability in SQL Server that enables authorized attackers to bypass authentication controls and gain elevated system privileges remotely. Tracked as CVE-2026-20803, the vulnerability stems from missing authentication mechanisms for critical functions within the database engine. The flaw…
